name: witness-gate
description: Fail-closed accountability layer for agentic AI: eight versioned, evidence-fed witness assessors evaluate an agent's proposed action before it executes; every judgment is sealed and written to a tamper-evident hash-chained attestation record, with assessor dissent preserved rather than averaged away.
use_of_funds: Standalone open-source release of the witness-gate core: rubric versioning, MCP server integration so MCP-compatible agents can request a verdict before acting, hash-chain attestation library with verification tooling, documentation, worked examples, and a security review of the attestation path.
maintenance: Actively maintained by Mythara Labs LLC — the gate runs in the founder's own production systems daily (it gated the company's licensing outreach drafts in October 2026 and is the accountability layer under the MytharaOS/SoulCradle runtime).
